newsitem.title: USA: Hallmark Capital stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Hallmark Capital stake held by group.

text.p: A group including Financial Institution Partners L.P. and Hovde Capital Inc said Friday it holds a 9.84 percent stake in Hallmark Capital Corp or 142,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 20,000 common shares between Oct 16 and Nov 1 at prices ranging from $17.435 to $17.50 per share.
The stake is held for investment purposes, the filing said.
The West Allis, Wis.,-based company is a holding company for West Allis Savings Bank.
